series_key: three aspects of manual trading automation
mechanism: Author rejects explicit higher-TF screens (dual MA, Alligator, Elder) for intraday work and instead senses short-term trend/entry context from a zigzag plus point-and-figure chart built on the same working M5 and M15 charts, treating that geometry as the regime map while trading only one order per symbol.
data_needed: OHLC on M5 and M15 for the chart symbol; zigzag pivots; point-and-figure box construction on those TFs (method named, not coded in this part).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT4 Symbol(); author working periods M5 and M15; intraday/scalping; one order per symbol
why_new_for_mis: Same-TF structural regime sensor (zigzag+PnF) as a deliberate substitute for multi-TF trend stacks—keeps MIS regime state on the execution timeframe without higher-TF lag.
quote: I do not use them in an explicit form. Instead, I do just fine with a combination of the zigzag and point and figure chart that I plot based on the current 5 and 15 minutes.

series_key: three aspects of manual trading automation
mechanism: After RSI buffers are filled, emit discrete command events via terminal global variables: buy open when RSI path RSI[3]≤50, RSI[2]≤52, RSI[1]>52 (cross above 52) with Stop at Close[0]−DefaultStop; sell open when RSI[3]≥50, RSI[2]≥48, RSI[1]<48 (cross below 48) with Stop at Close[0]+DefaultStop; start 50%-profit trailing (command 7) when RSI crosses below 45 or above 55. EA one-order lock prevents re-fire spam.
data_needed: RSIBuffer series (at least bars 1–3); Close[0]; DefaultStop (demo 150*Point); WindowHandle; TimeCurrent; #Trader-* global variables.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart Symbol()/Period(); standard RSI example; Strategy Tester visualization only (not optimizable); MT4
why_new_for_mis: Turns oscillator threshold crossings into timestamped open vs trail-start change events on a shared sensing bus—MIS can treat indicator state transitions as typed regime-change messages, not continuous plots.
quote: a new order opens if the RSI crosses level 52 in the downward direction or level 48 in the upward direction. … The automatic trailing mechanism with respect to 50% of profit kicks in at the intersection of level 45 and 55.

series_key: three aspects of manual trading automation
mechanism: Read live MODE_SPREAD / Ask–Bid (or Close[0]±spread in tester). If command price CmdPrice lies inside [CurBid, CurAsk], direction is undefined and the open is rejected; CmdPrice < CurBid → buy-stop side; CmdPrice > CurAsk → sell-stop side. Spread interior is a hard liquidity microstructure gate before any order.
data_needed: MarketInfo MODE_SPREAD and MODE_STOPLEVEL; Ask/Bid or tester Close[0]; script drop price CmdPrice.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT4 symbol with Ask/Bid; live account or Strategy Tester visualizer; StopLevel-constrained offsets
why_new_for_mis: Uses the live bid–ask band itself as a liquidity sensing gate: prices inside the spread cannot encode direction—useful MIS filter when mapping level touches near the quote interior.
quote: if ( CurBid <= CmdPrice && CmdPrice <= CurAsk ) { SetError("Stop inside spread. Undefined trade direction."); … }

series_key: three aspects of manual trading automation
mechanism: Trader (or indicator) sets TralStart price via COMMAND_TRALSTART / TRALSTART0LOSS / TRALSTART50PROFIT. Trailing is inactive until bid≥TralStart (buy) or ask≤TralStart (sell); on first trigger, optionally snap SL to open±Tral0LossGap (breakeven) or midpoint between open and current price (lock ≥50% open profit), then step-trail by TralStep with MaxAllowedRisk still enforced.
data_needed: Open order ticket/type/lots/SL; TralStart; ZeroLossTral/HalfProfitTral flags; Tral0LossGap; TralStep; CurBid/CurAsk; AccountBalance risk %.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Single open order on chart Symbol(); intraday M5/M15 context; MT4 live or visualizer
why_new_for_mis: Separates a sensed price-break event (hit TralStart) from ongoing trail mechanics—MIS can treat ‘profit-run armed’ as a distinct post-entry state change, including BE vs half-profit arming modes.
quote: Right after opening, you can specify the price upon reaching which the Expert Advisor will begin to trail the accumulated profit. … #TRAL-START0LOSS … move the Stop Loss to the breakeven point … #TRAL-START50PROFIT … save at least 50% of the accumulated profit at the trailing start.
